description: Get all comments on a Confluence page, footer and inline, with their replies, including their body content and version info. Each comment carries its type (footer or inline) and parent_id, the comment it replies to, or null for a comment on the page itself. An inline comment also carries the page text it is anchored to and whether it is open or resolved.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

page_id.description: The ID of the page whose comments to retrieve.

name: atlassian-mcp__confluence_get_comments
